messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — billing run 2026-03 produced a phantom invoice for PaperTrail Inc. (customer pt-42). invoice_id INV-202603-7890 shows a non-zero total but every line item is empty. anyone seen this before? :facepalm:
Maya Patel: ugh saw something similar in a smaller batch earlier today, thought it was a render/display bug in the invoice PDF. did you check raw lines in the db? :eyes:
Alex Chen: just pulled raw JSON from invoices.lines: all entries are [] but invoice.total_amount_cents = 125000. looks like lines failed to materialize but total got set.
FinanceBot: automated-alert: billing-job v2 (run 2026-03-21T02:14Z) completed with status=partial_success. created 1 invoice(s) with missing lines. job_id=billing-20260321-02:14.
Sam Ortega: repeating query now: ```sql
SELECT id, external_id, customer_id, total_amount_cents, array_length(lines,1) AS lines_count FROM invoices WHERE external_id = 'INV-202603-7890';
-- RESULT: ( "5501", "INV-202603-7890", "pt-42", 125000, 0 )
```
Jordan Lee: that's a critical inconsistency. suspect two separate code paths: total calc and line assembly. any recent deploys affecting invoice assembly?
Olivia Grant: FYI we flipped pricing.v2_proration flag on production 2026-03-20 around 23:58 for the reserved-capacity experiment. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/prs/7891. Could that change the line generation hook?
Maya Patel: timeline lines up. when v2 proration enabled, invoice_builder upgraded to call ProrationV2.calculate_lines() (non-blocking). if that throws, we might still set totals from cache. need logs.
Alex Chen: pulled job logs, sees this exception right before invoice write:```
ERROR InvoiceBuilder: NoUsageLinesFound(customer=pt-42)
  File "services/billing/invoice_builder.py", line 218, in build_lines
    raise NoUsageLinesFound(customer_id)
  File "services/billing/proration/v2.py", line 47, in calculate_lines
    assert usage_records, "no usage"
```
Maya Patel: so calculate_lines raises, but outer code catches and continues to persist invoice with precomputed total. bug: exception swallowed.
Sam Ortega: quick mitigation: we can patch the job to abort on exceptions or fallback to legacy proration. want me to toggle pricing.v2_proration off?
Jordan Lee: do that but first check impact. how many invoices created like this? run a sweep query:```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE array_length(lines,1)=0 AND total_amount_cents>0 AND created_at > '2026-03-20';
-- -> 12
```
Olivia Grant: 12 affected, includes 3 enterprise customers. we should avoid toggling flags during billing cycle if possible, but rollback seems necessary.
Alex Chen: action items: 1) Maya will open a postmortem / assign bug (can we create a ticket?) 2) Sam will toggle flag to off and re-run billing job in staging, 3) Jordan/Olivia to patch invoice_writer to not persist totals when lines missing.
Maya Patel: creating ticket now. FinanceBot: ticket created TICK-4521 (billing-invoice-missing-lines). link: https://issues.redwood/TICK-4521
Maya Patel: Sam please coordinate with infra to replay billing-run after toggle and keep me copied. I will notify affected customers after we confirm corrected invoices.
Sam Ortega: toggling pricing.v2_proration -> OFF in prod feature-flag service (referencing run id billing-20260321-02:14). will update when done. :point_right:
FinanceBot: featureflag-update: pricing.v2_proration set to OFF by Sam Ortega at 2026-03-21T03:02Z.
Jordan Lee: also creating a small hotfix: wrap ProrationV2.calculate_lines in a safe wrapper that returns legacy_lines on failure. sending PR now.
Alex Chen: thanks all. quick patch + replay should fix invoices. Maya, let's prepare manual crediting plan in case some customers already paid against the phantom total.
Olivia Grant: noted. I'll draft customer outreach and finance-approved credit memo template.
Maya Patel: will close loop here after replay. tagged: @FinanceOps @EngOncall.
Alex Chen: closing for now. follow-up ticket TICK-4521 will track remediation and customer comms. :white_check_mark:
